# Lessons Learned

Historical records of lessons learned during development sessions.

Lessons are logged automatically by `/review --focus=retrospective` at the end of
a session, or manually via `scripts/create-doc.sh lesson "Lesson Title"`.

See [docs/history/README.md](../README.md) for naming conventions and usage.
